dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: The existing clean-relative owner exclusively validates observations, computes within-Scenario pair differences, constructs provenance, and validates the immutable artifact.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Typed frozen CleanCalibrationObservation and CleanCalibration records expose units, identity, sample counts, source hash, resolutions and fail-closed validation; callers do not pass simulator objects or open dict payloads.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The deterministic domain owner depends only on standard-library scalar/identity primitives and the candidate Outcome type; no runner, simulator, replay, optimizer or filesystem dependency was added.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Producer and consumer are stateless; the frozen artifact validates source and content hashes before consumption and no partial mutation can escape.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The Effect Sketch ends at the proposal-only calibration owner and two focused tests. Active v009 and training callers do not import this module.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Focused S1 producer/consumer tests and the module-alignment manifest prove offline semantics only; real telemetry, formal connectivity and policy quality remain explicitly unclaimed.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Although the boundary uses scalar records rather than tensors, field order, physical units, Scenario/repeat identity, ZMP applicability, finiteness and row permutation are explicit and tested.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: This proposal-only deterministic calibration module does not construct a loss, gradient or optimizer update and is not connected to training.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: No checkpoint/evaluation integration is authorized; the artifact content/source hashes prepare that future boundary but do not prove serialization or official-route consumption.
